en.clientes_agencia_intermediaria.body: A trendy agency with a foosball table wants you to execute a major brand project end to end. They pocket 55% for 'account management' and forbid you from ever mentioning the work is yours.
en.clientes_agencia_intermediaria.choices.a: Swallow the ghostwriter clause to secure the invoice
You deliver the whole project while three account executives forward your emails taking all the credit. Payment lands on time, though your pride stings.
en.clientes_agencia_intermediaria.choices.n: Demand full senior rates and portfolio credit
Nobody else can deliver on time, so they cave. You charge what your craft is worth and add a flagship case study to your portfolio.
en.clientes_agencia_intermediaria.choices.r: Decline being invisible labor for someone else's slide deck
You close the video call with an impeccable smile and dedicate the week to your own direct clients.
en.clientes_agencia_intermediaria.title: White-label subcontracting: you grind, they sign
en.clientes_agencia_prueba_remunerada.body: Borja spins up a pop-up agency and asks for a 'short pilot proposal' at a token fee to woo a major company. He swears on his honour you'll lead the whole annual account once they win.
en.clientes_agencia_prueba_remunerada.choic: Bill the capped pilot with your authorship clearly stamped
You deliver strictly within scope with clear technical credit on every page. Modest fee today, unmistakable authorship tomorrow.
Refuse to subsidize someone else's pitch with your hours
Borja mutters about your 'lack of strategic vision' while you reclaim a clean week for real clients.
Grind all weekend betting on the promised annual contract
Your deck dazzles the end client and Borja pays a solid first slice while bragging loudly about 'his in-house team'.
They win the pitch using your slides, then hand execution to three interns so Borja can pocket the entire margin.
en.clientes_agencia_prueba_remunerada.title: 'Just a tiny paid test so we win the annual pitch'
en.clientes_app_millonaria_primo.body: A distant cousin corners you over espresso alongside Borja: they've dreamed up 'Uber meets condo board meetings'. There is zero cash today, only a generous 8% of an unincorporated company.
en.clientes_app_millonaria_primo.choices.co: Quote a small Phase 1 prototype paid on a real invoice
Once €800 of real money hits the table, they trim the wishful thinking, split the bill for a lean mockup, and pay for your time.
en.clientes_app_millonaria_primo.choices.en: Burn midnight oil gambling on phantom equity
Against every law of thermodynamics, a property-management firm buys the working prototype and you cash out a glorious windfall.
After two months of endless voice notes, your cousin gets bored and decides the real future lies in farming gourmet mushrooms.
en.clientes_app_millonaria_primo.choices.pa: Pay for the coffees and bolt before signing a napkin
Best three euros spent all quarter. You return to your desk safe, sound, and still in charge of your evenings.
en.clientes_app_millonaria_primo.title: 'I bring the million-euro idea, you just build it'
en.clientes_archivos_perdidos_hace_dos_anos: A client silent for twenty months emails in panic: they lost every master file you delivered back then and assume your studio hard drives serve as their eternal free cloud backup.
Bill an archive-retrieval and format-migration fee
Dusting off an external drive and updating legacy formats turns their slip-up into an easy afternoon invoice.
Send the backup free as goodwill while pitching a support plan
Scared straight, they thank you profusely and sign a three-month backup and maintenance retainer.
They download the zip in three minutes flat and reply solely with a thumbs-up emoji.
Cite your twelve-month archive purge policy for closed jobs
Two polite lines close the thread without digging through cold-storage drives for free.
'We wiped our laptop and lost everything from two years ago'
en.clientes_auditoria_alcance_berlin.body: The Berlin team loves Phase 1 and proposes rolling the project out across three European markets. They pay Northern European rates, provided you join crisp 8:30 AM sync calls three mornings a week.
en.clientes_auditoria_alcance_berlin.choice: Take the full rollout with a fresh thermos at dawn
Your mornings start in English before the corner bakery opens, yet that intra-EU transfer makes every dark circle worthwhile.
Bill a clean handover session and skip the expansion
You hand over tidy documentation, invoice a wrap-up fee, and keep your mornings blissful.
Negotiate async written updates with zero early calls
You prove crisp weekly memos beat daily meetings. They agree gladly, keeping both the European fee and your mornings intact.
en.clientes_auditoria_alcance_berlin.title: European expansion with 8:30 AM standup calls
en.clientes_auditoria_senior_corporativa.bo: Five-plus years in the game bring a call from a major firm to audit and untangle a stalled project that already chewed through two consultancies. They approve your senior specialist rate without blinking.
en.clientes_auditoria_senior_corporativa.ch: Direct strategy and split heavy execution with your employee
Your senior judgment guides the scalpel while your hire handles implementation—top-tier billing without burnout.
Pass on inherited fires and protect your neck and sanity
Turning down three grand feels dizzying for half a second; stretching out pain-free on the sofa cures it fast.
Lead the intensive audit and turnaround solo from start to finish
In three weeks you unblock a year-old mess, banking a memorable windfall while dreaming in flowcharts.
en.clientes_auditoria_senior_corporativa.ti: High-stakes corporate rescue at veteran specialist rates
en.clientes_automatizacion_propia_ia.body: With disarming corporate candor, Marta asks you to hand over your custom templates and automated workflows in a workshop so her juniors 'can run everything in-house without hiring freelancers'.
en.clientes_automatizacion_propia_ia.choice: Price the handover and usage license like premium consultancy
If they want to buy the fishing rod, they pay yacht prices: two workshop afternoons net a handsome invoice.
Refuse to give away your secret sauce and sell outcomes only
You guard your internal toolkit with a warm smile: the magician's props aren't included in general admission.
Set up a basic workflow paired with a four-month oversight fee
Their juniors handle repetitive grunt work while you bill four calm months making sure nothing catches fire.
en.clientes_automatizacion_propia_ia.title: 'Teach our juniors your AI workflows so we won't need you'
en.clientes_avalancha_cierre_presupuesto_di: Marta calls in peak holiday panic: her department found leftover annual budget that vanishes next year unless invoiced and delivered before New Year's Eve. Great fee, goodbye holidays.
Take the holiday sprint and invoice every euro before midnight
You grind straight between Christmas Eve and New Year's, closing December with a spectacular revenue spike.
Close for the holidays: January will bring fresh budgets anyway
You toast the New Year without opening your laptop once all season.
Scope a sharp five-day strategic deliverable that fits cleanly
They get an impeccable report to justify their budget line, and you still make every holiday dinner relaxed.
December 20th: 'We must burn this budget before the 31st'
en.clientes_averia_equipo_trabajo.body: Tuesday, 11 AM: your main workstation emits a faint burnt-toast aroma and dies forever with three client deliverables half-finished. Without your primary rig, billing drops straight to zero.
en.clientes_averia_equipo_trabajo.choices.c: Buy a new pro-grade machine on a tax-deductible invoice
Swiping the card hurts, yet you unbox a fast, silent machine today and deduct the expense on your next quarterly return.
en.clientes_averia_equipo_trabajo.choices.p: Pay for an emergency patch job at the corner repair shop
It dies again ten minutes before sending the final file. You end up paying double for a refurbished rig while apologizing profusely.
The tech revives the motherboard with solder and faith. It sounds like a helicopter, yet you hit every deadline and save the week.
en.clientes_averia_equipo_trabajo.choices.r: Sign a four-month equipment lease to bridge the gap
A loaner rig arrives that afternoon without draining your cash reserves at once, adding only a manageable monthly lease fee.
en.clientes_averia_equipo_trabajo.title: Black screen in the middle of a deadline
en.clientes_boda_amigo_encargo_en_b.body: A friend of a friend asks for a well-paid private job over terrace beers, dropping the national classic: 'I'll hand you crisp bills so we skip the VAT bite—it stays between friends'.
en.clientes_boda_amigo_encargo_en_b.choices: Pocket the wad of cash under the table with zero paperwork
Tax-free bills slide straight into your wallet, plus nagging wonder over how many dinner guests will hear about it.
Offer a small friend discount on a 100% legal VAT invoice

Plead a full calendar to avoid mixing beers and invoices
Referring another freelancer keeps the friendship intact and spares you awkward money talk.
en.clientes_boda_amigo_encargo_en_b.title: 'Come on, between friends you won't charge me VAT'
en.clientes_bono_subvencion_digital.body: Borja wants to hire you using a public modernization grant: forty pages of timestamped proof reports, delayed official payout, plus a shady wink about 'splitting the grant money between us'.
en.clientes_bono_subvencion_digital.choices: Deliver real work and document every single legal requirement
You fill out compliance forms until your eyes blur, delivering genuine value for a clean, guaranteed payout.
Pad the scope and slip him the off-the-books kickback he wants

en.clientes_bono_subvencion_digital.title: The labyrinth of subsidized digitalization vouchers
en.clientes_boom_boca_oreja.body: Someone praised your work at an industry lunch and a small miracle happens: three serious quotes get approved in the same week without haggling. Sadly, the day still only has twenty-four hours.
en.clientes_boom_boca_oreja.choices.abarcar: Say yes to all three before anyone changes their mind
You bill like a freight train for four weeks straight, though by month's end you mistake the salt shaker for your wireless mouse.
en.clientes_boom_boca_oreja.choices.convert: Convert the lead client into a four-month retainer
You trade a chaotic spike for predictable monthly revenue. Knowing what you'll bill on the first almost feels like a salary.
en.clientes_boom_boca_oreja.choices.elegir_: Keep the highest-margin project and refer the rest to peers
You work at a healthy margin, look like class personified in the guild, and bank favours for leaner months ahead.
en.clientes_boom_boca_oreja.title: Snowball effect: three serious clients at once
en.clientes_cambiecito_grupo_whatsapp.body: Without asking, Borja drops your personal number into a group chat with his brother-in-law, two partners, and sales. Every ten minutes someone requests 'a tiny tweak' contradicting the previous text.
en.clientes_cambiecito_grupo_whatsapp.choic: Mute the chat for a year and stick strictly to baseline scope
You ignore 140 late-night voice notes, ship exact contracted specs, and keep your sanity intact.
Exit the chat and demand one point of contact via email

Stay in chat and reply to every whim with a euro add-on fee
Their internal debates end up padding your final bill with three delicious change-order supplements.
Putting a euro tag on his brother-in-law's third whim makes Borja mute the chat and approve version one.
en.clientes_cambiecito_grupo_whatsapp.title: You were added to 'Project Rocket Launch 🚀'
en.clientes_campana_navidad_contrareloj.bod: Holiday lights have hung since November, yet Borja wakes up today demanding a full Christmas campaign in forty-eight hours—offering either an official rush invoice or 'a festive cash envelope'.

Untaxed gift cash lands in your pocket alongside a mediocre ham and twenty-one points of Hacienda curiosity.
Pull off the Christmas miracle on a legal rush invoice

en.clientes_campana_navidad_contrareloj.tit: Dec 16th: Borja realizes Christmas is next week

Toss him a thirty-minute patch just to get rid of him forever

en.clientes_cliente_final_puentea_agencia.b: Two months later, Marta calls directly from the client company: Borja's agency crashed trying to execute your proposal without you. They've fired the agency and want to hire you straight away.
en.clientes_cliente_final_puentea_agencia.c: Stay out of the crossfire and stick to your current roster
You skip Borja's angry voice notes and enjoy the karmic fireworks comfortably from the sidelines.
Sign directly with the company at full unclipped rates

en.clientes_cliente_husos_horarios_eeuu.bod: A California company approves your quote without haggling a cent and wires upfront in dollars. The catch: their 'bright and early morning sync' lands right in your soup at 10:30 PM Spanish time.
en.clientes_cliente_husos_horarios_eeuu.cho: Take the project, open a multi-currency account, and work late

en.clientes_comision_derivacion_colega.body: An overloaded fellow freelancer offers to hand you a pre-sold mid-sized project in exchange for a 10% finder's fee—either properly invoiced as a deductible cost or 'in an envelope over coffee'.
en.clientes_comision_derivacion_colega.choi: Thank them warmly and pass the referral along to another peer
You bank goodwill in the guild without sacrificing your evenings this week.
Take the project and pay the 10% referral on a clean invoice

Settle off the books and slip them cash at the corner café
Both of you dodge taxes today over espresso while stacking another untraceable cash trail.
en.clientes_comision_derivacion_colega.titl: A swamped guild peer offers you a turnkey client
en.clientes_concurso_acreedores_proyecto.bo: Three weeks into a major job, your emails bounce and the gazette confirms it: the client just filed for insolvency. External middleman Borja whispers that before receivers arrive 'you might rescue cash in hand'.

By the time you arrive, the locks are already changed: no envelope, no client, no pay—just a wasted trip and heartburn.

Write off the loss today and repurpose the generic work
You swallow hard crossing off the expected payout, cover out-of-pocket costs, and recycle the best pieces into your pitch deck.
File a credit note through your gestor to recover the VAT
You hit every legal deadline to avoid gifting Hacienda the VAT on an unpaid bill and salvage a clean partial settlement.

en.clientes_conferencia_magistral_sector.bo: A national conference and a business school both invite you this month to lead a senior masterclass on your craft. Speaker honorariums are generous and the room is packed with decision-makers.
en.clientes_conferencia_magistral_sector.ch: Prep both events thoroughly and maximize senior visibility
You reach Friday hoarse, yet you bank a splendid speaker fee and pocket business cards from no-haggle clients.
Thank them warmly and stay cosy at your own desk
You skip building eighty slides past midnight and enjoy a calm week at home.
Take only the higher-paying executive workshop with zero travel

en.clientes_conferencia_magistral_sector.ti: Paid industry keynote and executive masterclass
en.clientes_consejo_asesor_mensual.body: Four years in the trenches earn Marta's pitch to join a mid-sized firm's monthly steering committee as external advisor: less manual grind and prestige fees, paired with boardroom pressure.
Sign the six-month executive advisory retainer

Decline the cross-border sprint and put personal life first

Marta frowns briefly yet respects your independence as you rebalance revenue across healthier accounts.

en.clientes_dependencia_cuenta_gigante.titl: When a single client becomes half your studio
en.clientes_desierto_agosto.body: Half of Spain is at a beach bar and your inbox only echoes out-of-office replies until September. A desk fan stirs warm air in your silent studio while the bank queues up every fixed monthly debit.
en.clientes_desierto_agosto.choices.bajar_p: Pull the shutters down properly and unplug for two weeks

en.clientes_desierto_agosto.choices.campana: Run a promo campaign to catch orphaned August emergencies

en.clientes_desierto_agosto.choices.ordenar: Use the quiet spell to update rates, templates, and tax files

en.clientes_desierto_agosto.title: August: closed for holidays (except your quota)
en.clientes_dilema_sabatico_cartera.body: Seven years of relentless quarters bring a lucrative rush project to your desk alongside deep fatigue a single Sunday on the sofa can no longer cure. You have to choose your pace.

Grit your teeth one more time and bank the rush project

Freeze new intake for thirty days to reset body and head

en.clientes_dilema_sabatico_cartera.title: Seven years in the trenches: body versus billing

en.clientes_encargo_urgente.choices.entrega: Pull overtime and charge upfront with a rush surcharge

en.clientes_encargo_urgente.choices.presupu: Accept at a sane pace on a 60-day invoice

en.clientes_encargo_urgente.choices.rechaza: Say your schedule is full and rest this week

en.clientes_encargo_urgente.title: 'It was due yesterday, super quick job though'
en.clientes_esposas_oro_iguala_vip.body: A VIP client offers a five-month renewal at a spectacular monthly fee, yet their executives have grown used to texting Sunday nights expecting full answers before Monday's first coffee.
Renew strictly with a written Friday-to-Monday offline clause

en.clientes_esposas_oro_iguala_vip.title: Golden handcuffs: huge monthly retainer, zero sleep
en.clientes_evento_networking_canapes.body: A local SME networking night opens downtown. The ticket is tax-deductible and promises genuine leads, provided you trade your couch for two hours of small talk in smart-casual shoes.
en.clientes_evento_networking_canapes.choic: Buy the deductible ticket (€65) and target three real businesses

Survive the red-tape obstacle course and float them 90 days

Decline the offer: you aren't an interest-free bank

en.clientes_factura_corporativa_90_dias.tit: Vendor onboarding and ninety-day payment terms
en.clientes_factura_electronica_face_rechaz: You delivered a municipal job on time, yet the FACe e-invoicing portal bounces your bill a third time: City Hall quietly changed one digit of its accounting unit code and nobody picks up the phone.

en.clientes_iguala_urgencias_mensual.body: Marta wants guaranteed priority access to your studio for the next five months. They pay a handsome monthly retainer on top of base billing, expecting replies to urgent tickets in under two hours.
en.clientes_iguala_urgencias_mensual.choice: Refuse the electronic leash and stick to fixed-scope projects

en.clientes_moroso_reincidente.body: With an older invoice still unpaid after three excuses about 'a SEPA batch glitch at the bank', Borja pops back up cheerful as ever demanding a brand-new rush job for tomorrow.

Total budget was €150, and now he waves penalty clauses if you even roll your eyes in public.
Refuse five-figure liability clauses before hearing a budget
You save a whole afternoon of disproportionate legal cosplay.
Nuclear-grade NDA for a pocket-change budget
en.clientes_operacion_salida_julio.body: Last week of July at thirty-eight degrees: three clients panic at once demanding final files before heading to the coast—even though nobody will open a single attachment until mid-September.
Enforce your own 3 PM summer schedule and skip new rush jobs
You taste the revolutionary joy of summer half-days as a freelancer, trading peak cash for sanity.
Send clean previews now and schedule final polish for September
Everyone leaves for the beach happy without you sacrificing sleep over files nobody would read in August.
Crank the AC and bill all three pre-holiday closings
You reach August 1st melted into your chair with a splendid cash buffer for the quiet summer stretch.
en.clientes_operacion_salida_julio.title: Late-July stampede: everything is urgent before the beach
en.clientes_pagare_corporativo_noventa_dias: Right before signing a major corporate order, Marta warns you Treasury doesn't wire funds: they issue a physical 90-day paper IOU you must pick up at reception or discount at your bank.
Accept and discount the paper IOU at the bank (€180 fee)
Your branch manager rubs his hands over the fee, yet cash lands right away and the financing charge is tax-deductible.
Deliver the order and lock the paper IOU away for 90 days
You guard that stamped slip of paper like a sacred relic, praying funds clear smoothly ninety days from now.
Walk away from the order: you accept bank wires only
You pass on the contract rather than collecting twentieth-century paper IOUs and dodge ninety days of suspense.
A paper promissory note straight out of 1990
en.clientes_pago_especie_trueque.body: When it's time to pay for a finished job, Borja admits his account is dry and offers half by wire and half in cases of wine and spa vouchers 'off the books so nobody pays tax'.
en.clientes_pago_especie_trueque.choices.ac: Take the off-the-books cash-and-wine deal and stock the pantry
Pocket cash and good wine brighten your dinners, alongside sixteen fresh points of undeclared barter risk.
en.clientes_pago_especie_trueque.choices.ex: Refuse the wine: Social Security doesn't take bottles
You lock him into a two-part euro payment plan—half wired today, half documented for next month.
en.clientes_pago_especie_trueque.choices.pe: Write off the unpaid balance and block his number for good
You forfeit the remaining balance in exchange for never hearing another wine-barter pitch again.
en.clientes_pago_especie_trueque.title: 'Cash is tight, how about twelve cases of Rioja reserve?'
en.clientes_pago_sin_factura.body: Borja appears late Friday with a 'super simple' job due Monday. He winks and lowers his voice: 'Skip the paperwork, I hand you cash on Sunday, and everybody goes home happy'.
en.clientes_pago_sin_factura.choices.acepta: Take the off-the-books envelope and grind all weekend
Sunday night brings a bakery envelope stuffed with crumpled bills. Instant tax-free liquidity, though every parked white van spikes your pulse.
Upon delivery, Borja pulls out just €950 grinning like a shark: 'Since you save on taxes, we both win'. And you have zero legal recourse.
en.clientes_pago_sin_factura.choices.declin: Turn down the mess and rescue your weekend
You wish him luck finding another volunteer at eight on a Friday night, shut the laptop, and reclaim your Sunday rest.
en.clientes_pago_sin_factura.choices.exigir: Official invoice with VAT and withholding, strictly by the book
Borja sighs as if you'd asked for a kidney, then signs the official quote. You set aside the quarterly tax share and sleep soundly.
en.clientes_pago_sin_factura.title: 'With VAT, or... shall we sort it out between us?'
en.clientes_propuesta_remota_berlin.body: A German tech firm spots your portfolio and offers a well-paid Phase 1 contract in English. Billing them VAT-free across borders requires valid intra-EU VIES registration on your tax census.
en.clientes_propuesta_remota_berlin.choices: Pay for translation and tax prep to make the contract airtight
Deductible prep buys you a spotless bilingual contract and VIES setup. Berlin is impressed by your operational polish.
Decline politely: Spanish tax forms are plenty of excitement
You thank them warmly without adding cross-border tax forms or English calls to your week.
File the intra-EU registration and dive in with your English
You survive the census form and two German-punctual video calls. They wire the exact sum on the due date without haggling a cent.
en.clientes_propuesta_remota_berlin.title: Remote client in Berlin and intra-EU VAT paperwork
en.clientes_proyecto_escaparate.body: A high-profile cultural festival invites you to lead its flagship campaign. The fee barely covers costs, yet Borja swears trade-press coverage will put your name on the national map.
en.clientes_proyecto_escaparate.choices.apo: Go all in to flex creative muscle and win prestige
The campaign looks gorgeous, except the press release omits your name entirely and only thanks the beer sponsor.
For once in history, the exposure was real: trade outlets credit your work and inquiries arrive from clients with adult budgets.
en.clientes_proyecto_escaparate.choices.pas: Thank them politely and save energy for euro-paying clients
You watch opening night from the couch with zero dark circles and zero regrets.
en.clientes_proyecto_escaparate.choices.pre: Quote standard commercial rates: supermarkets don't take prestige
They trim scope to match what they can actually afford, and you bill a fair job without donating sleepless nights.
en.clientes_proyecto_escaparate.title: 'Budget is tight, but the whole industry will see you'
en.clientes_proyecto_fantasma_anticipo.body: A new client approves your quote in half an hour, wires the deposit, and asks you to block two full weeks on your calendar. They swear the key source materials will land 'tomorrow morning without fail'.
en.clientes_proyecto_fantasma_anticipo.choi: Block the two weeks, invoice the deposit, and prep the base
You bill the deposit and lay out the entire project scaffolding while awaiting their files. So far, it smells like a dream client.
Pass on the job rather than locking two straight weeks
You avoid mortgaging half a month at once and keep capacity open for existing clients.
Sign with an expiry clause if source files arrive late
You bank the deposit with ironclad scheduling terms: if they vanish, their slot drops to the back of the queue penalty-free.
en.clientes_proyecto_fantasma_anticipo.titl: Enthusiastic kickoff with a thirty-percent deposit
en.clientes_reaparicion_urgente_fantasma.bo: Your vanished client rises from the dead on Tuesday at 8 PM as if ten minutes had passed: 'We finally have the files! Since it was nearly done anyway, we can wrap up this Thursday, right?'.
en.clientes_reaparicion_urgente_fantasma.ch: Charge a reactivation fee plus 100% of the balance upfront
Time travel carries a toll. They wire the full remaining milestone plus surcharge, and you finish it over two intense afternoons.
Hand over what the deposit covered and decline the rest
You send a tidy archive matching their initial deposit and wish them luck. Your peace of mind has a strict no-zombies policy.
Skip the surcharge but schedule it in your next real 30-day slot
They drop the panic once they grasp you weren't frozen in amber waiting for them. You finish at a sane pace and bill the rest.
en.clientes_reaparicion_urgente_fantasma.ti: 'Sorry, crazy few months! We need it live by Thursday'
en.clientes_recomendacion_excliente_directi: A manager you worked wonderfully with years ago just joined a solvent company as department director. Her message is music: 'I want to bring you in directly without a three-agency pitch'.
Send a sharp proposal and execute her flagship kickoff project
Pre-built trust feels like another sport entirely: zero haggling, clear goals, and punctual month-end payment.
Thank her over coffee and keep this month's workload light
You nurture the relationship over a relaxed coffee without overloading your current schedule.
Propose a smooth four-month advisory deal for her first quarter
You back her first hundred days on the job with steady monthly revenue and mutual respect.
A former client lands a director role and calls you first
Contract renewal arrives and Marta drops the bomb in polished corporate-speak: Finance mandates a 20% fee cut across external vendors while expecting the exact same deliverables.
Hold full rate by showing what switching vendors would cost
Onboarding a replacement would cost them triple; Finance backs down and renews at 100%.
Decline below-market rates and free capacity for healthier clients
You part ways gracefully rather than teaching corporate buyers your rates are made of putty.
Accept 20% less pay only by trimming 20% of the deliverables
Cheerful mathematical symmetry wins the day: smaller bill, smaller scope, identical hourly margin.
'To renew this year we need a twenty-percent haircut'
en.clientes_renegociacion_iguala_inflada.bo: Checking your time tracker confirms your gut feeling: a monthly retainer scoped at ten hours now devours nearly thirty thanks to endless 'quick five-minute questions' from Marta's team.
en.clientes_renegociacion_iguala_inflada.ch: Stay quiet out of fear they might cancel the contract
You avoid an awkward call while watching your effective hourly rate sink toward pocket change.
Share a live hour tracker and pause strictly at hour ten
Every Friday they receive an exact balance of remaining hours—an instant cure for pointless meetings.
Present the real time logs and upgrade the retainer fee
Hard numbers leave zero room to argue: they sign the higher tier and you finally bill every hour worked.
Budget stays flat, so they ruthlessly cut extra requests to stay inside ten hours—handing you twenty free hours back.
en.clientes_renegociacion_iguala_inflada.ti: The ten-hour retainer quietly eating twenty-eight
en.clientes_renovacion_cartera_veterana.bod: Half a decade surviving quarterly filings pays off as your longest-standing accounts renew together for next semester. Marta leads a lucrative retainer bundle, though sixty-hour weeks hit harder now.
en.clientes_renovacion_cartera_veterana.cho: Drop burnout accounts and renew only the highest-margin tier
You pull rank: Sunday callers are let go, leaving a mature, profitable roster compatible with eight hours of sleep.
Sign the full bundle and maximize billing another six months
You lock in formidable monthly cashflow at the price of living glued to your phone and collecting neck spasms.
Renew sustainably by paying external backup for peaks (€420)
You trim today's margin with deductible freelance backup, keeping historic clients happy without mortgaging your health.
en.clientes_renovacion_cartera_veterana.tit: Block renewal of your old-guard client roster
en.clientes_renovacion_pagare_tesoreria.bod: Days before the promissory note matures, Marta calls sounding tight-lipped: Finance wants to roll over a slice to window-dress quarterly books, dangling a no-bid add-on job in return.
en.clientes_renovacion_pagare_tesoreria.cho: Accept the accounting rollover in exchange for the signed add-on
You flatter their quarterly balance sheet and pocket a lucrative extra commission, ending the week thoroughly drained.
Collect what's due, skip the add-on, and ban future paper IOUs
You close the file in peace and add a bold line to every quote template: bank wire only.
Cite Spain's Late Payment Act and demand full settlement on time
They pay every cent on the due date, though Marta quietly parks your name in procurement's penalty box for a while.
Mentioning statutory late-payment interest works wonders: cash materializes in Treasury and they settle with compensation.
en.clientes_renovacion_pagare_tesoreria.tit: Treasury wants to 'reprofile maturity' for quarter-end
en.clientes_rescate_desastre_generativo.bod: One month later Borja calls on the verge of tears: his nephew's output published fabricated figures to a flagship client and broke their workflow. He begs you to rebuild it from scratch by Monday.
en.clientes_rescate_desastre_generativo.cho: Rebuild only the critical core during weekday hours at senior rate
You staunch the bleeding across three structured weekdays, bill handsomely, and refuse to sacrifice your weekend.
Charge double 'demolition and rebuild' rate upfront
He wires double your original quote without a peep before you open a single folder. Poetic justice tastes magnificent.
Gently suggest asking his nephew for one more prompt
You hang up savouring the sweetest silence of the quarter and enjoy an unbothered weekend.
en.clientes_rescate_desastre_generativo.tit: Live meltdown: the AI deliverable hallucinated everything
en.clientes_retainer_europeo_consolidado.bo: After a smooth European rollout, Berlin offers to make you their go-to external specialist on a five-month retainer. Transfers hit on the first like clockwork, paired with high quality expectations.
en.clientes_retainer_europeo_consolidado.ch: Thank them and stick to occasional standalone projects
You keep the relationship warm without monthly obligations and enjoy a well-earned breather.
Agree to a half-capacity advisory retainer to stay sane
You secure a steady monthly cushion covering fixed studio costs without swallowing your entire workweek.
Sign the full five-month European retainer
You lock in five months of punctual Northern European billing. Local peers ask whether Berlin is adopting more freelancers.
en.clientes_retainer_europeo_consolidado.ti: German retainer wired on the first of every month
en.clientes_reunion_diaria_falso_autonomo.b: Marta issues you a corporate email, books mandatory 9 AM daily standups, and asks you to notify HR before doctor visits—all while paying zero Social Security or holiday pay on your behalf.
en.clientes_reunion_diaria_falso_autonomo.c: Put your B2B schedule independence in writing and bill milestones
One mention of independent contractor rules sends HR scrambling to cancel roll call out of labour-audit fear.
End the arrangement before they make you clock out for coffee
You hand back the internal login and reclaim true ownership of your mornings.
Swallow the office leash without paid holidays for steady cash
You endure the worst of salaried life and freelance taxes combined, though the monthly wire clears.
en.clientes_reunion_diaria_falso_autonomo.t: Daily 9 AM roll call and disguised-employee vibes
en.clientes_silencio_radio_mitad_entrega.bo: Weeks have passed since that eager kickoff and the client has vanished into thin air. Calls and emails go unanswered, the main milestone sits unbilled, and your calendar has a question-mark-shaped hole.
en.clientes_silencio_radio_mitad_entrega.ch: Send a formal hold notice and free up your schedule
You shelve the files cleanly, note a reactivation fee in writing, and fill the open week with paying work.
Close the file for good and keep the initial deposit
You shut the folder without looking back: lower total billing than planned, zero uncertainty hanging overhead.
Keep chasing them weekly while holding their calendar slot
You burn mornings sending polite follow-ups into the void while turning down smaller gigs just in case they reply today.
en.clientes_silencio_radio_mitad_entrega.ti: Radio silence with the project seventy percent done
en.clientes_sobrino_experto_prompts.body: Borja waves off your quote triumphantly: his nineteen-year-old nephew 'already generated the whole thing with AI' and he only wants to pay you two hundred euros for 'a quick professional polish'.
en.clientes_sobrino_experto_prompts.choices: Charge a fixed diagnostic fee just to list what's broken
You bill an upfront diagnostic assuming zero liability and hand him twelve pages of hilarious hallucinations.
Congratulate the prodigy nephew and take the afternoon off
You archive the thread with zen serenity and go for a walk without touching a line of that experiment.
Refuse the 'quick polish' and leave your real quote standing
You politely explain that untangling automated spaghetti costs more than building it right from scratch. He'll be back.
en.clientes_sobrino_experto_prompts.title: 'My nephew generated it with a five-minute prompt'
en.clientes_subasta_inversa_compras.body: Marta invites you to Procurement's latest bright idea: a thirty-minute live online bidding war where three freelancers watch a timer and undercut each other on screen to win the contract.
en.clientes_subasta_inversa_compras.choices: Enter your standard rate at minute one and don't touch the mouse
The lowball winner bails four days later upon reading the real specs, so Marta awards it at your full rate.
Someone reckless wins at half price; you close the browser with your dignity and hourly rate intact.
Jump in and slash margins to the bone just to win volume
You win by twenty euros and spend three grueling weeks working at discount-supermarket margins.
Decline the invite: you sell expertise, not wholesale fish
You politely opt out of race-to-the-bottom auctions and spend the morning on clients who respect craft.
en.clientes_subasta_inversa_compras.title: Live reverse auction on the vendor portal
en.clientes_subcontrata_cascada_impago.body: Chasing an overdue invoice reveals Borja's outfit was subcontracted by an agency subcontracted by a larger consultancy. They claim 'pay-when-paid' means you wait until the top of the pyramid settles.
en.clientes_subcontrata_cascada_impago.choi: Take a 20% haircut for instant wire today and sever ties
Losing a fifth stings, yet cash clears today and you vow never to be link four in a chain again.
Write off the bad debt today rather than throwing good money after it
You cross off the invoice through gritted teeth, blacklist pyramid middlemen, and move on.
Send formal notice: your contract is with them, not the pyramid
Pointing out their upstream risk isn't legally yours loosens their wallet fast to avoid small-claims court.
en.clientes_subida_tarifa_veterania.body: Six years into freelancing, tiny nitpicky gigs drain energy meant for flagship accounts. Borja turns up haggling over three micro-jobs right while serious clients are waiting for quotes.
en.clientes_subida_tarifa_veterania.choices: Require prepaid ten-hour blocks upfront for any small requests
No more tiny administrative invoices: anyone wanting small tasks buys a full prepaid block upfront.
Turn down Borja's micro-gigs and catch up on rest
You let the loose change walk away guilt-free and spend the week catching up on sleep.
Enforce a strict minimum project fee and drop small-fry work
Volume dips slightly during the first transition month, bringing astonishing mental quiet and a spotless studio.
Borja flees in horror, and a solvent corporate client immediately fills the open capacity at full margin.
en.clientes_subida_tarifa_veterania.title: Year-six filter: minimum project fee or the highway
en.clientes_subida_tarifas_ipc.body: Electricity, rent, olive oil, and software licenses have all climbed, yet your rates remain frozen since day one. Time has come to send regulars the dreaded annual rate-update email.
en.clientes_subida_tarifas_ipc.choices.anun: Announce a firm +15% adjustment with one month's notice
After two theatrical sighs, serious clients accept without blinking and only the loudest penny-pincher walks away.
Borja stages a dramatic scene and cancels a couple of minor gigs, leaving a brief dip and wonderfully quiet afternoons.
en.clientes_subida_tarifas_ipc.choices.borr: Delete the draft out of fear and swallow inflation another year
You keep every single client at the cost of working longer hours for less real purchasing power.
en.clientes_subida_tarifas_ipc.choices.subi: Nudge rates up a token amount while practically apologizing
Nobody gets upset, though the tiny bump barely covers the hike on your mid-morning café con leche.
en.clientes_subida_tarifas_ipc.title: Operation raise your rates without dying trying
en.clientes_version_final_definitiva_ok.bod: Nine rounds of corporate micro-edits in, Marta forwards notes from a newly arrived VP asking to revert straight back to the exact concept they killed in version two.
en.clientes_version_final_definitiva_ok.cho: Hold version twelve until they sign an extra-hours purchase order
Showing the signed approval trail makes three departments grumble, then approve a healthy supplemental order.
Deliver the final contracted round and close the ticket
You end the infinite loop with polite resolve—zero extra billing, intact sanity.
Pull version two out of your backups and bill final sign-off
Thank goodness you hoard old drafts: twenty minutes later they get their own U-turn back gleaming and you bill closure.
en.clientes_viernes_urgencia_corporativa.bo: House keys in hand, your phone buzzes non-stop. Marta calls from an airport taxi: executive leadership moved the presentation to Monday at 8:30 AM and wants the entire deliverable rebuilt this weekend.
en.clientes_viernes_urgencia_corporativa.ch: Let your office-hours auto-responder handle it until Monday
You silence the phone and enjoy Saturday like a free citizen. Marta is frosty on Monday, yet nobody died over a slide deck.
Accept with a savage weekend-emergency surcharge
You bill like a Swiss surgeon in exchange for zero sunlight until Monday. By 8 AM the file is in her inbox and you look like a raccoon.
Split weekend shifts with your employee plus overtime pay
You divide the crunch with military precision, pay generous overtime, and reach Monday with an impeccable file and intact neurons.
en.clientes_viernes_urgencia_corporativa.ti: Friday, 7:30 PM: 'The board moved it up to Monday'
en.clientes_ya_que_estas.body: Thirty seconds after receiving the final deliverable, Borja replies: 'Love it! Hey, while you're in there, could you also redo the old section and three versions for my partner? Ten-minute job tops'.
en.clientes_ya_que_estas.choices.enviar_ane: Smile politely and attach a separate quote for the extras
Borja grumbles about 'how nickle-and-diming freelancers got', then signs the add-on because nobody else answers his calls.
The instant euro signs appear, he miraculously realizes the current version 'was already spot-on'. Twenty unpaid hours saved.
en.clientes_ya_que_estas.choices.remitir_a_: Point with surgical calm to the signed revision clause
You cite clause four without raising your voice. A respectful silence follows, he pays the final milestone, and stops asking for freebies.
en.clientes_ya_que_estas.choices.tragar_par: Give in 'just this once' and burn three unpaid nights
That 'ten-minute tweak' mutates into eighteen unbilled hours and four absurd revision rounds. Borja is thrilled; your dignity is in ICU.
en.clientes_ya_que_estas.title: 'While you're in there, it's just clicking one button'
en.empleados_actualizacion_convenio_ipc.bod: Another year closes with rising prices and the annual collective pay adjustment lands on your desk. Decide whether to raise pay above inflation, offset it with deductible perks, or freeze real wages.
en.empleados_actualizacion_convenio_ipc.cho: Absorb the hike into existing allowances so payroll stays flat
It is strictly legal on paper, yet seeing the exact same net payslip month after month cools any enthusiasm for going the extra mile.
Apply the full inflation raise and pass new rates on to clients
You update client rates unapologetically, protect your employee's purchasing power, and maintain zero turnover like a seasoned studio.
Cover deductible training and gear (390 €) with a modest pay bump
You cushion fixed monthly payroll by pairing deductible studio perks with comfortable hours, keeping quarterly cash flow steady.
en.empleados_actualizacion_convenio_ipc.tit: Annual Wage Scale and Inflation Review
en.empleados_alianza_red_colaboradores.body: Two complementary freelancers suggest bidding together under a shared umbrella brand for a juicy private contract none of you could land solo. No company merger or payroll, just shared deadlines and egos.
en.empleados_alianza_red_colaboradores.choi: Draft a written milestone and revenue-split agreement first (180 €)
You spend an afternoon and a modest legal fee putting every share in writing. You win the opening phase with crystal-clear rules.
Kick off on a handshake and a toast so you don't lose the client
You win phase one and dive straight into a lively group chat overflowing with enthusiasm and zero clauses about overtime.
Skip collective experiments and stick to your own client roster
You pass on the big showcase project, sparing yourself three-way coordination calls at eight in the evening.
en.empleados_averia_equipo_trabajo.body: Midway through Tuesday, your employee's main computer dies with a dry spark while the office chair creaks like a galleon. Upgrading hardware stings cash today, yet lending junk slows every delivery.
Rent a professional replacement laptop for this month (260 €)
You save the sprint without draining cash all at once: a clean fix, a deductible invoice, and zero immediate technical drama.
Lend your 2016 spare laptop whose fan roars like a jet engine
Every heavy file takes ages to open, and daily frustration drags down commercial output across the whole studio.
Buy a fast workstation and ergonomic chair, deductible (1,150 €)
By tomorrow the new setup hums in dead silence, weekly output climbs, and you book a clean tax deduction for the quarter.
en.empleados_averia_equipo_trabajo.title: Burnt-Circuit Smell at the Next Desk
en.empleados_baja_medica_temporal.body: Monday, 8:30 a.m.: your employee sends a temporary medical leave note for acute back spasms requiring weeks of strict rest. You wish them well—right before remembering social security fees still auto-debit.
en.empleados_baja_medica_temporal.choices.a: Shoulder two people's workload yourself by pulling late nights
You keep accounts afloat solo, burning cash on takeout coffee and physio sessions while counting the days until that desk chair is occupied again.
Renegotiate client deadlines and accept a temporary studio slowdown
You explain the bottleneck honestly: a few commissions slip and commercial momentum cools for months, yet you avoid burning out alive.
en.empleados_baja_medica_temporal.choices.c: Pay deductible external backup (680 €) and respect their rest 100%
You cover the gap with freelance help without sending a single message during sick leave. Your wallet feels it, but clients and loyalty stay safe.
en.empleados_baja_medica_temporal.title: Sick-Leave Note on a Deadline Monday
en.empleados_candidatura_espontanea_dani.bo: After toughening up on solo gigs for a few months, Dani writes back with a sharper portfolio and far less stage fright. He asks whether your studio can now afford him full-time or on a monthly retainer.
en.empleados_candidatura_espontanea_dani.ch: Take the leap and bring Dani onto payroll now (1,400 €/mo, ×1.35)
He arrives far more focused than before, untangles the delivery queue by Tuesday, and frees up prime hours for you to close better sales.
Agree on a deductible four-month external hours retainer (520 €)
You offload repetitive tasks without permanent payroll contributions, giving both of you breathing room to test day-to-day chemistry.
Thank him warmly and stay solo until your cash cushion grows
Dani takes it well and promises to check back next season. You close the email relieved not to stretch fixed overhead past your blanket.
en.empleados_candidatura_espontanea_dani.ti: Dani Knocks on Your Studio Door Again
en.empleados_choque_trato_cliente_borde.bod: A high-billing client loses their temper live on screen and rudely blames your employee for a delay the client caused. Once the call ends, the room goes dead silent waiting to see how you respond.
en.empleados_choque_trato_cliente_borde.cho: Take over all calls with that client yourself and grant afternoon off
You shield your employee from the toxicity and save the invoice, at the price of absorbing every tense call yourself all month.
Send a firm written boundary demanding respect and routing contact
Thirty minutes later the client backs down by email, and loyalty inside your small studio shoots through the roof.
Bruised pride makes the client cancel the next phase. Cash takes a ding this month, yet your employee would walk through fire for you.
Say coldly that whoever pays calls the shots and not to make waves
The wire transfer lands on time, yet something vital cracks for good in the trust between the two desks.
en.empleados_choque_trato_cliente_borde.tit: Disrespect on a Group Video Call
en.empleados_contraoferta_competencia.body: A competing consultancy dangles twenty-five percent higher pay in front of your employee if they jump ship in two weeks. They ask to talk today before signing anything right in the middle of peak deliveries.
en.empleados_contraoferta_competencia.choic: Accept you can't match it and agree on a clean two-week handover
You part ways gracefully with zero severance payout, hiring brief freelance cover so active clients barely notice the transition.
Retain them with a 600 € bonus and project profit-sharing
They turn the consultancy down that same afternoon. Cash tightens short-term, but you protect studio know-how and ignite commitment.
Threaten non-compete clauses and enforce every day of notice
Legal hardball freezes their signature on the spot, turning the office atmosphere icy and setting up a bitter standoff.
en.empleados_contraoferta_competencia.title: Aggressive Counter-Offer from a Rival Agency
en.empleados_convenio_becario_universidad.b: A local training school asks if you will host a student intern for one quarter. Done properly it brings fresh energy into the office, yet real mentoring takes hours and must never substitute cheap labor.
en.empleados_convenio_becario_universidad.c: Sign the internship with a fair 450 € stipend and real mentoring
You structure genuine learning tasks and review progress calmly. Mornings run slower, yet tidying your own workflows sharpens the studio.
Thank the coordinator and decline until you have time to teach
You admit honestly that this quarter is too hectic to mentor anyone properly. The school appreciates your candor and keeps your card.
Use the placement to dump urgent client grunt work off your plate
After three afternoons putting out fires alone, the student cancels the placement. You redo deliverables overnight as word spreads at school.
You squeeze extra billing out of repetitive tasks with minimal guidance. The school signs off barely, leaving a frosty tutor report.
en.empleados_curso_especializacion_ia.body: Dani arrives beaming with a brochure for a hands-on workflow automation course that promises to halve repetitive production chores. He asks the studio to cover deductible tuition and Thursday afternoons.
en.empleados_curso_especializacion_ia.choic: Turn it down this quarter because the client queue won't wait
You keep every euro in the bank today, while Dani quietly closes the browser tab and goes back to copying spreadsheet rows by hand.
Split half the tuition (240 €) if he studies outside work hours
Dani takes the compromise: he applies half the syllabus without cutting billable hours, though dark circles show by Friday.
Pay deductible tuition (480 €) and reserve Thursday afternoons
By week three Dani builds templates that save hours of manual data entry—and brags about your studio to everyone he meets.
en.empleados_curso_especializacion_ia.title: Dani Asks to Sponsor an Intensive Course
Dani shows up Monday with a dangerous gleam in his eye: over the weekend he coded a bot that drafts reports across fifteen accounts at once. If it works you save days; if it misfires, every client sees it.
Spend two afternoons testing it on dummy data before launch
Together you catch three embarrassing bugs in staging and ship a polished tool that unlocks clean extra billing without a single scare.
Trust his enthusiasm and flip it live on real accounts today
The script runs like clockwork, clearing two weeks of routine reporting in forty-eight hours to universal applause.
A loop mails mismatched drafts to four rival clients. You spend the week apologizing one by one and issuing goodwill discounts.
Praise the initiative but stick strictly to manual checks
Zero technical scares hit production, though Dani parks his prototype in an archive folder looking visibly deflated.
en.empleados_delegacion_direccion_cuentas.b: After years of checking every comma yourself, your employee knows the roster cold and offers to lead weekly client check-ins directly so you stop acting as the bottleneck on every single project.
en.empleados_delegacion_direccion_cuentas.c: Delegate day-to-day calls while keeping a biweekly Friday review
You shed operational drag without losing commercial visibility, making the whole studio nimbler overnight.
Hand over account ownership with a 500 € responsibility bonus
Six weekly status calls vanish from your calendar, upsells close faster, and for the first time you breathe like an actual studio owner.
Keep filtering every single client reply yourself just in case
Nothing leaves without your stamp, leaving you exhausted proofreading drafts at nine p.m. while capping your own growth.
en.empleados_delegacion_direccion_cuentas.t: Handing Over the Wheel on Client Calls
en.empleados_entrega_imposible_salvada.body: A strategic client pulls a major deadline forward while you are trapped untangling urgent red tape. When you check outbox, your hire has already reorganized tasks, polished details, and saved the contract.
en.empleados_entrega_imposible_salvada.choi: Offer a pat on the back and pocket the margin ('that's what pay is for')
They take it like a pro and your bank balance enjoys the full fee, though you know you just burned a goodwill token.
The invoice clears cleanly, yet a hollow 'nice job, champ' leaves an unmistakable chill hanging between the two desks.
Buy lunch and reinvest part of the fee in ergonomic desk gear
You collect the full milestone and deduct upgraded studio gear—a smart balance between protecting cash and rewarding grit.
Share the win with a 450 € spot bonus and Friday off
The client signs off with written praise and genuine pride fills the office. You trim your margin today to lock in pure gold.
en.empleados_evaluacion_fin_practicas.body: The training placement wraps up and Dani now knows your templates, shortcuts, and quirks better than half the industry. Diploma in hand, he asks eagerly if there is a real payroll spot or freelance work.
en.empleados_evaluacion_fin_practicas.choic: Hire Dani onto payroll already trained (1,400 €/mo, ×1.35)
Zero onboarding lag: Monday morning he sits down knowing where every folder lives, and studio output jumps without missing a beat.
Sign top marks on his evaluation and stay solo for now
You hand over stellar references and a farewell gift. The quiet desk feels slightly empty, but monthly fixed costs stay lean.
Write a glowing reference and commission his first paid gig
You skip fixed payroll overhead while co-delivering a paid client brief that launches his freelance career and clears your inbox.
en.empleados_evaluacion_fin_practicas.title: End of Internship and Next Steps
en.empleados_fichaje_senior_laura.body: Laura, a senior specialist fed up with pointless meetings at big consultancies, wants to join a small studio built on craft rather than smoke. Her monthly salary commands respect, yet unlocks top-tier accounts.
en.empleados_fichaje_senior_laura.choices.a: Partner with her externally on one demanding brief without payroll
You team up on a high-ticket project and deduct her freelance invoice. The client is thrilled and you sleep free of permanent overhead.
en.empleados_fichaje_senior_laura.choices.d: Decline honestly: your cash reserve still prefers traveling light
Laura respects the plain speaking with zero corporate jargon and stays in touch for when your balance sheet grows.
en.empleados_fichaje_senior_laura.choices.f: Hire Laura onto full payroll (2,150 €/mo, billing ×1.65)
Within forty-eight hours Laura has organized folders, templates, and workflows held together with tape. Payroll is dizzying, yet you play in the big leagues.
en.empleados_fichaje_senior_laura.title: A Heavyweight Senior Hire
en.empleados_incendio_produccion_viernes.bo: Ten minutes before wrapping the week, Dani goes pale clutching his giant thermos: while cleaning temp files he overwrote the final build due Monday at 9 a.m., and the cloud backup stopped halfway through.
en.empleados_incendio_produccion_viernes.ch: Call the client yourself, own it as a studio, and deliver Tuesday
You take responsibility without throwing anyone under the bus and offer a small courtesy credit, earning respect inside and out.
Tear into him and demand he fix it alone over the weekend
Unsupervised and panicked, Dani ships a visibly broken patch. Monday brings a forced client discount and a funeral mood in the office.
Dani grinds all Saturday and salvages the delivery on his own, though come Monday he barely lifts his eyes from the keyboard.
Breathe deep, order dinner, and rebuild the deliverable side by side
You reconstruct everything before midnight and set up bulletproof backups. Dani learns more in one evening than in three bootcamps.
It takes half of Saturday to stitch the pieces back together, yet by 8:55 a.m. Monday the client gets a clean delivery none the wiser.
en.empleados_incendio_produccion_viernes.ti: Friday at Seven: Wrong Folder Deleted
en.empleados_jornada_intensiva_agosto.body: With street thermometers flirting with forty degrees, your employee asks to switch to Spanish August intensive hours until 3 p.m. and lock summer leave—right as a foreign client demands afternoon calls.
en.empleados_jornada_intensiva_agosto.choic: Pay a voluntary 450 € summer bonus to cover two afternoons a week
Extra pay softens the August heat: international calls run smoothly and you invoice a solid summer retainer.
Approve intensive hours and move the foreign client to mornings
Focused work happens early while minds are fresh and laptops shut at three. Raw hours dip slightly, yet nobody melts at their desk.
Enforce full split afternoon hours because the foreign contract rules
Every late call gets answered under the rattling air conditioner, though studio morale drops into the cellar.
en.empleados_jornada_intensiva_agosto.title: Heatwave and August Intensive Hours
en.empleados_laura_auditoria_clientes_toxic: Laura opens her ring-bound notebook to devastating charts: two legacy accounts chew up nearly half the studio's support emails while contributing scraps of revenue. She proposes raising rates or firing them.
Let Laura send updated pricing with strict scope boundaries
One accepts the hike without blinking and the other magically learns to batch questions into a single weekly email. Pure sorcery.
Keep them anyway out of superstitious fear of quiet months
A trickle of euros still arrives, while Laura sighs in quiet resignation every time another absurd 'quick tweak' email lands.
Wind down those draining accounts politely to free up capacity
You give up small immediate cash so the studio can land far healthier, higher-margin commissions over the next five months.
en.empleados_laura_limite_urgencias_tarde.b: At 5:55 p.m. a client emails demanding an unscheduled overhaul for tomorrow morning for no real reason. Laura closes her laptop firmly, warning that caving to fake emergencies ruins every studio process.
en.empleados_laura_limite_urgencias_tarde.c: Send Laura home on time and stay late handling the mess yourself
You honor her six-o'clock boundary while eating cold dinner at your screen at 11 p.m. wondering who actually works for whom.
Press her to stay late with you tonight as a one-off exception
You push the file out over two tense evening hours, and Laura makes a silent mental note of the crossed line.
Back Laura and quote an express rush fee if they want it tomorrow
Suddenly either the 'life-or-death' rush can wait or they approve the surcharge on the spot. Laura smiles, proud to be on your ship.
en.empleados_laura_limite_urgencias_tarde.t: Five to Six and a Fake Client Emergency
en.empleados_mediacion_salida_tensa.body: One month after clashing over the rival offer, every internal message reads like legal exhibits and output has tanked. A labor lawyer urges you to unlock the standoff before formal conciliation hearings.
en.empleados_mediacion_salida_tensa.choices: Settle a clean departure with counsel and severance (1,250 €)
Both sides sign a settlement waiving further claims. Your bank balance winces, yet peace of mind returns the very same afternoon.
Hold the legal line all the way to the formal conciliation board
Playing hardball backfires: you pay 2,100 € in severance plus legal bills to avoid court, and word travels around the sector.
Outside the hearing room you close the exit for 300 € plus legal fees, though the emotional grind leaves you wrung out.
Apologize for the hardball tone and sign real upgrades (400 €)
Owning up defuses the trench warfare. Putting fair terms in writing salvages the working relationship before it breaks.
en.empleados_mediacion_salida_tensa.title: Glacial Silence and Labor Conciliation Threat
en.empleados_mudanza_local_calle.body: Working in slippers beside drying laundry saves cash, yet you can no longer tell where the living room ends and work begins. A shared street-level studio and a neighborhood coworking desk just opened up.
en.empleados_mudanza_local_calle.choices.al: Take a share in the street-level studio (650 € move-in setup)
You get keys, set up far from your sofa, and host clients with decent coffee. Fixed costs rise, yet pulling the shutter at dusk frees your head.
en.empleados_mudanza_local_calle.choices.pr: Book a flexible desk at the neighborhood coworking space (220 €)
You trade hallway walls for daylight, fast fiber, and human small talk by the espresso machine without signing a long lease.
en.empleados_mudanza_local_calle.choices.se: Stay home and keep every single euro of office rent in the bank
Your checking account stays untouched, even if your monitor still glares at you from across the room every Sunday night.
en.empleados_mudanza_local_calle.title: Escaping the Ironing-Board Bedroom Office
en.empleados_negociacion_condiciones.body: Your employee asks for twenty minutes behind closed doors with a notebook full of fair points: living costs rose, recruiters are messaging, and they want either higher pay or hybrid work with Fridays off.
en.empleados_negociacion_condiciones.choice: Approve a performance-linked pay raise for the next six months
Monthly overhead climbs, yet commitment shows immediately in delivery pace—and you avoid training someone new from scratch.
Refuse for now, blaming quarterly taxes and tight fixed overhead
Two weeks later they hand in formal notice after signing elsewhere. Zero severance owed, and you are suddenly back to flying solo.
They stay put for the moment, though after-hours favors vanish overnight and polite distance settles over morning check-ins.
Offer hybrid remote work and free Fridays instead of raising fixed pay
Payroll stays flat while you trade a sliver of Friday-afternoon capacity for a dramatically happier, calmer studio.
en.empleados_negociacion_condiciones.title: Pay Review or Four-Day Week
en.empleados_oferta_fuga_cliente.body: After months delivering spotless work together, you learn Marta's department quietly approached your employee to hire them in-house—conveniently cutting out your studio margin in the process.
en.empleados_oferta_fuga_cliente.choices.bl: Pay a 550 € retention bonus and enforce your clause with Marta
Your hire appreciates the backing and stays put, while Marta renews the contract respecting your studio's boundaries.
en.empleados_oferta_fuga_cliente.choices.no: Refuse a bidding war with a corporation and appeal to studio culture
They choose the freedom of your small studio over endless corporate committees, turning down the offer at zero cost to you.
Fourteen corporate payslips win out: formal notice lands on your desk mid-quarter, and scrambling deliveries costs you cash.
en.empleados_oferta_fuga_cliente.choices.pa: Negotiate a billed transfer fee for the handover and go solo again
You close a civilized professional transition, invoice a healthy transfer fee, and wipe fixed monthly payroll off your books.
en.empleados_oferta_fuga_cliente.title: Poaching Attempt from the Client Side
en.empleados_paga_aniversario_estudio.body: More than five years in business, your studio marks another year shipping complex work as a team. Time for a grown-up boss call: share results with a special bonus or hoard every liquid euro for taxes.
en.empleados_paga_aniversario_estudio.choic: Pay an 850 € anniversary profit bonus to cement long-term loyalty
Your bank balance feels the dip, yet shared pride propels commercial output across the entire next six months.
Open the books and explain this year calls for conserving cash
Every euro stays safely in the bank, though the anniversary passes without fanfare and daily momentum noticeably cools.
Reward with deductible advanced training (360 €) and extra days off
You balance appreciation with fiscal caution, sharpening studio skills without draining your quarterly tax reserve.
en.empleados_paga_aniversario_estudio.title: Studio Anniversary and Loyalty Bonus
en.empleados_primer_fichaje.body: Incoming work is starting to swamp you when you meet Dani, an eager junior looking for a stable first break. Bringing him into your tiny office will multiply your output—right alongside your fixed bills.
en.empleados_primer_fichaje.choices.fichar_: You file the social security paperwork and clear half a desk. Monday morning Dani arrives with a liter thermos, fresh notebook, and contagious energy.
en.empleados_primer_fichaje.choices.seguir_: Thank him warmly and keep rowing solo for now
Paying your own monthly self-employed quota is plenty of adrenaline without taking on a payroll. Dani leaves his card for later.
en.empleados_primer_fichaje.choices.subcont: Offer a one-off freelance collaboration to clear the current backlog
You ship a big commission and deduct his freelance invoice: thinner net margin than doing it all solo, with zero fixed payroll next month.
en.empleados_primer_fichaje.title: An Extra Pair of Hands
en.empleados_red_veterana_subcontratas.body: After years surviving solo, three trusted senior subcontractors offer to reserve priority capacity for your studio next semester so you can land major accounts without hiring permanent staff.
en.empleados_red_veterana_subcontratas.choi: Advance a deductible 780 € retainer and lock in major commissions
You punch like a boutique agency with zero permanent payroll, absorbing big billing spikes while keeping total independence.
Stick to project-by-project freelance splits with no upfront retainer
You co-deliver a solid commission paying their share on completion and carry zero commitments into next month.
Pass on priority slots and stick strictly to craft solo accounts
You wave bigger contracts goodbye and savor the quiet craft of relying solely on your own keyboard.
en.empleados_red_veterana_subcontratas.titl: Your Black Book of On-Call Specialists
en.empleados_reestructuracion_despido.body: After a couple of tight months, meeting a fixed payroll on the 28th starts keeping you awake staring at bank statements. Decide calmly whether to hustle new sales to save the job or downsize with severance.
en.empleados_reestructuracion_despido.choic: Agree on an amicable exit with full severance (1,450 €) and references
It is a hard conversation, yet you part with mutual respect and clean accounts. The office falls quiet again and fixed overhead drops.
Execute a bare-minimum dismissal payout to shield cash reserves
Severance closes at 750 € without going to court, though the goodbye is icy and word always gets around in a small industry.
Cutting corners triggers a formal labor conciliation claim: you end up paying 1,900 € in severance plus legal advisory fees.
Protect the job, trim wasteful subscriptions, and pitch new business
You cut bloat, grit your teeth together, and close a fast commercial push that justifies keeping the team intact.
en.empleados_reestructuracion_despido.title: Scissors or Reinvention in the Studio
en.empleados_registro_horario_obligatorio.b: Over coffee, a neighboring business owner warns that Labor Inspectors are auditing tiny studios for mandatory daily clock-in records. Right now your time tracking consists of good faith and a crumpled sticky note.
en.empleados_registro_horario_obligatorio.c: Subscribe to a simple compliant mobile clock-in app (210 €)
Setup takes ten minutes, digital disconnect hours are clear, and you sleep soundly knowing every timestamp log is audit-ready.
Print monthly paper timesheets and chase ink signatures every Friday
Software costs zero euros, though every month ends hunting for a pen and filing ring binders like it is 1994.
Ignore the paperwork assuming nobody inspects a two-desk office
An official notice arrives for missing time logs, sticking you with a non-deductible 750 € fine and an expensive lesson.
Months roll by without a peep from the ministry, sparing you one more bureaucratic chore.
en.empleados_relevo_senior_proyecto_clave.b: Years into your career, a flagship client asks for continuity guarantees in case the flu knocks you flat. Laura is free either to join your payroll or sign a mutual cross-coverage pact as peers.
en.empleados_relevo_senior_proyecto_clave.c: Defend your solo boutique model and accept a smaller contract scope
The client trims scope out of caution, while you keep absolute ownership of your calendar and zero fixed payroll.
Bring Laura onto payroll to scale up (2,150 €/mo, ×1.65)
With Laura running technical delivery, the client signs the annual contract on the spot and your studio stops depending on your throat.
Sign a deductible mutual backup retainer with Laura as peers
You present a rock-solid continuity plan between senior independents, winning the big account without permanent payroll.
en.empleados_reparto_proyecto_conjunto.body: The client approves the final milestone on your joint freelance bid, and tension surfaces: one collaborator claims an extra slice of your fee, arguing their eleventh-hour edits saved the pitch.
en.empleados_reparto_proyecto_conjunto.choi: Pull out the signed split agreement and settle to the exact euro
Written clauses end the debate in five minutes with zero hard feelings. Everyone invoices cleanly, ready to team up again.
Give up part of your margin to keep the peace and preserve ties
You swallow hard, cover their extra hours out of your share, and keep the professional bridge intact—at a thinner profit.
Refuse unapproved overruns even if sparks fly across the group
You hold firm and collect every euro of your share, though that freelance alliance is officially history.
An ill-advised reply-all spills the argument in front of the client, who trims final scope fed up with bickering suppliers.
en.empleados_subcontratacion_pico_trabajo.b: Three dormant quotes get approved on the exact same Tuesday morning. With nobody on payroll, you must quickly outsource to a trusted peer, gamble on bargain gig platforms, or cap what you accept.
en.empleados_subcontratacion_pico_trabajo.c: Accept only what your own hands can deliver and refer the rest
You bill less this month, deliver surgical quality, and earn goodwill for refusing to overpromise.
Farm modules out to the lowest bidder on a fast-turnaround site
Unusable slop arrives hours before deadline. You eat the fee and spend all weekend rebuilding everything from scratch.
After two evenings polishing rough edges, the work passes muster and you pocket nearly the entire surge margin.
Subcontract a trusted senior peer on a deductible invoice
Paying fair rates to a pro pays off: all three projects ship on schedule, net margin stays healthy, and you sleep seven hours.
en.empleados_subcontratacion_pico_trabajo.t: Delivery Bottleneck in a Crunch Fortnight
Priced out of city rent, your employee plans to relocate two hours away by train and asks to switch to full remote work, commuting in once a month to plan sprints at the studio.
Approve full remote and cover home-office stipend plus train (240 €)
Freed from a two-hour daily commute, focus jumps noticeably—and you even save on mid-morning coffee pods.
Insist the role is on-site and settle an agreed exit (650 €)
You stick to your in-person rule, losing a trained teammate and inheriting the entire pending backlog overnight.
Sign a reversible three-month remote trial tied to clear milestones
Short Monday check-ins and clear deliverables keep output steady without spending extra cash or losing trained talent.
Moving Out of Town and Full Remote Work
en.familia_adaptacion_guarderia.body: Daycare unveils its famous settling-in schedule: forty-five minutes on Monday, ninety on Tuesday, and a radioactive runny nose by Thursday. Just as you open your laptop, they call about a mild fever.
en.familia_adaptacion_guarderia.choices.can: Pause minor gigs, mute notifications, and stay home caring
You lose immediate billings among storybooks and syrups, but the little one bounces back fast and the living room stays sane.
en.familia_adaptacion_guarderia.choices.con: Pay a backup sitter by the hour to save your deadlines (290 €)
Your bank account feels the sting, yet you wrap up the week without canceling calls or answering emails in the pediatrician's waiting room.
en.familia_adaptacion_guarderia.choices.tur: Split morning and night shifts with Álex fueled by strong coffee
The nursery virus takes no prisoners and knocks you both flat by Friday. You end up begging for extensions in a raspy croak.
You pass the thermometer and the mouse like Olympic relay runners. You survive the week exhausted, yet closer than ever.
en.familia_adaptacion_guarderia.title: Nursery Settling-In Week and the First Daycare Bug
en.familia_aniversario_olvido_agenda.body: You set three alarms for tax deadlines and zero for your own anniversary. At noon, a suspiciously brief message from Álex lands asking what time you are finishing work 'today of all days'.
en.familia_aniversario_olvido_agenda.choice: Sprint to the market and cook a proper candlelit dinner (55 €)
Your phone buzzes on the counter during dessert, and even though you ignore it, the last-minute scramble shows.
The risotto comes out spot-on, your favorite playlist fills the kitchen, and nobody mentions a single invoice all evening.
Shut down at six, buy a thoughtful gift, and book dinner (135 €)
You own up to the slip before starters without cheap excuses. Álex laughs at your tax-addled brain and you salvage a lovely night.
Admit you are swamped tonight and promise to make it up Saturday
You hit every client deadline on the dot, then eat dinner in the cold glow of your monitor beside a heavy silence.
en.familia_aniversario_olvido_agenda.title: You Remembered Quarterly VAT, Not Your Anniversary
en.familia_apoyo_racha_dura.body: You have spent days muttering numbers under your breath with a clenched jaw. Álex spots the exhaustion right away, sets down a hot plate, and offers real backup—covering shared bills this month or making you rest.
en.familia_apoyo_racha_dura.choices.aceptar: Let Álex cover groceries and utilities this month to ease cashflow
You swallow your lone-wolf freelancer pride and accept with gratitude. That breathing room keeps a tight month from turning ugly.
Let yourself be cared for this weekend, talk openly, and exhale
You sleep eight straight hours for the first time in weeks without dreaming of due dates. Monday's problems shrink back to normal size.
en.familia_apoyo_racha_dura.choices.disimul: Smile, claim 'everything is under control,' and get back to typing
You keep finances and worries to yourself and push a small gig out the door, though Álex can tell you are still carrying the weight.
en.familia_apoyo_racha_dura.title: Holding the Home Front Through a Rough Patch
en.familia_boda_fuera_plazo_entrega.body: Someone close to you is getting married across the country with Friday drinks, a marathon Saturday banquet, and Sunday lunch. Between the cash gift, hotel, and fuel, it hits your wallet right before a Monday delivery.
en.familia_boda_fuera_plazo_entrega.choices: Pay for travel, hotel, and a proper gift, leaving the laptop (490 €)
Nearly five hundred euros vanish in forty-eight hours, yet you dance, laugh with old friends, and remember you are more than a tax ID.
Attend the wedding and lock yourself in the hotel room on Sunday
You make every group photo and save Monday's invoice typing hungover beside the minibar, returning home more wiped out than Thursday.
Blame a work emergency, send a gift transfer, and stay home billing
You save travel costs and bank solid billings in silence while watching open-bar videos flood the group chat with a pang in your chest.
en.familia_boda_fuera_plazo_entrega.title: A Wedding Four Hundred Kilometers Away, Due Monday
en.familia_boda_prima_entrega_martes.body: Your favorite cousin is getting married on a holiday Monday at a rural estate with zero signal, while your pickiest client demands final files Tuesday at nine. Your aunt warns that skipping means moral disinheritance.
en.familia_boda_prima_entrega_martes.choice: Grind Saturday, hand over the gift envelope, and dance Monday (320 €)
You arrive at the estate with the files already sent, toast without checking the clock, and win eternal praise from the whole family.
Wire the wedding gift, fake a bad back, and stay home working
You nail Tuesday's delivery fresh as a daisy while your mother texts twelve photos of your empty chair at the cousins' table.
Join the banquet, then slip out after the cake to finish at dawn
You hit send at six in the morning smelling of wedding cologne, pulling off both commitments at the cost of three years of life.
Sleep deprivation scrambles the numbers in your deliverable, earning you a hungover Tuesday earful from the client.
en.familia_boda_prima_entrega_martes.title: Your Cousin's Long-Weekend Wedding and Tuesday's Deadline
en.familia_caldera_rota_enero.body: You step into the shower at 7:30 AM in mid-January to pure Arctic water while the boiler flashes a cryptic error code. Typing in a scarf kills the entrepreneurial vibe, and emergency call-outs charge just to say hello.
en.familia_caldera_rota_enero.choices.compr: Buy a cheap space heater and wait a week for standard repair (165 €)
You survive five days warming only one square meter under your desk, setting up a nasty surprise on your next electricity bill.
en.familia_caldera_rota_enero.choices.pagar: Pay the emergency repair today and restore heating by noon (410 €)
The invoice stings like frostbite, yet the radiators are purring again by lunchtime and you stop typing in mittens.
en.familia_caldera_rota_enero.choices.refug: Camp out for three days with your laptop in your parents' warm lounge
You dodge the emergency surcharge and eat hot homemade soup, in exchange for explaining hourly why you are still staring at a screen.
en.familia_caldera_rota_enero.title: Error E04: The Boiler Dies on a Freezing January Monday
en.familia_chequeo_medico_veterano.body: Four-plus years of running your own show catch up on your lab results without mercy: cave-dweller vitamin D, borderline blood pressure, and tired eyes begging for fresh lenses and actual rest.
Pick up pharmacy supplements and promise lighter dinners (45 €)
You get by without big spending or big miracles, though ten minutes of morning sun with breakfast helps a bit.
File the report beside old receipts and keep pushing at full speed
You squeeze out another heavy billing week while ignoring the warning signs and nursing a faint twitch in your left eyelid.
Get new glasses, overhaul your habits, and walk every day (280 €)
You stop squinting at the monitor, drop your third afternoon espresso, and feel clean energy return within weeks.
en.familia_chequeo_medico_veterano.title: Annual Bloodwork: Cholesterol, Eyestrain, and Coffee
en.familia_cita_con_alex.body: At a mutual friend's birthday you end up talking for three straight hours with Álex, someone with a salaried job and normal hours who finds quarterly taxes exotic. Before leaving, Álex suggests dinner—zero invoice talk.
en.familia_cita_con_alex.choices.apostar_po: Book a table, stash your phone in your bag, and see where it goes
Thursday dinner turns into Sunday breakfast, and before long there is a spare toothbrush in your bathroom. You are officially dating.
en.familia_cita_con_alex.choices.priorizar_: Politely pass for now: right now you are married to your cashflow
